text.tspan: FIT: split face; K post tops at Z -5.20 +0/-0.05; RF slot Y
Wedge: rear slope and 4.89 degree ramp are single planes;
foot pockets square to the ramp (ramp setup).
USB-C skin 0.60 thick in front of the inner pocket: below
the 0.8 recommendation, ask on the DFM review.
Battery pocket and relief rims R0.5 min, deburred, no sharp
edge (power 14 rule 3).
Laser mark from engraving_underside.dxf on the ramp (drawn
as seen from above, mirrored).
6061-T6. Bead blast, then Type II sulphuric anodise, black,
appearance Strict (enclosure 1).
General tolerance ISO 2768-m (a proposal, not a tested
requirement). Break edges 0.05 unless drawn.
Internal corners: R = depth/10 + 0.5 or more; the 2.0 mm
tool is needed where R 1.0 or R 1.05 is drawn.
Threads below M5 are plugged during anodise and stay bare
(JLCCNC).
Not ordered. Nothing has been milled. Check every fit on the
first article before the batch.
